subject: Next steps: Azure Marketplace publisher bootstrapping, technical dependencies & validation
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@microsoft.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Azure Marketplace publisher bootstrapping — initial artifacts and timeline

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for taking time today. As discussed on the call, we're ready to begin publisher onboarding for Contoso Retail (they're the initial customer in this deal) and want to make sure we have a clean path through the technical gate and offer creation. I've attached the manifest bundle and our validation test plan. Quick summary of asks so we can align end-to-end: 

- Confirm required publisher account permissions and whether Contoso needs a separate publisher or can be listed under Redwood's publisher tenant for co-sell.
- Verify the exact manifest attributes that will trigger the technical gate (runtime dependencies, ARM template references, required certificates).
- Any Azure Marketplace packaging restrictions for GPU-backed inference offers (we plan to include a Dedicated/Bring-Your-Own-Nodes option).
- Timeline: we'd like a technical validation window the week of Jan 4 — is that feasible on your side?

Attachments: redwood-manifest-v1.zip, validation-test-plan.pdf, publisher-org-proof.pdf

Next steps from our side: we can produce trimmed-down ARM templates and a brief POC runbook for Marketplace verification by 12/30. Laura and Markus are copied — they'll drive the artifacts.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@microsoft.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 13:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace publisher bootstrapping — initial artifacts and timeline

Tessa — thanks for the concise packet and the call earlier. A few clarifications and immediate items from the marketplace validation perspective: 

1) Publisher tenancy: For co-sell, Contoso can be published under Redwood's publisher ID only if Contoso signs a marketplace listing consent (we can attach a publisher consent template). Otherwise Contoso will need its own publisher tenant. If Contoso prefers to keep commercial branding separate, request their procurement/legal to confirm.

2) Permissions: To complete the technical validation we need a publisher administrator (MSA) with access to the Partner Center to submit the initial offer. Either you can submit under Redwood's tenant (preferred for speed) or Contoso invites the publisher admin role.

3) Technical gate checklist (high level):
- Package manifest (V1) that lists SKU types and VM sizes. Please ensure GPU SKU strings match Marketplace naming (we flagged a mismatch in redwood-manifest-v1.zip).
- Public ARM templates referenced by the offer; if you reference private storage accounts we need SAS tokens or a transient public URL for validation.
- Security evidence: minimal required docs are publisher-org-proof.pdf and SOC2 readiness note.
- Runtime verification: we'll run a short deployment to a Microsoft test subscription. For your GPU inference workload, please include an automated smoke test (script + sample input) in azure-poc-logs so we can validate inference startup and health checks.

4) Timeline: We have an available validation slot on Jan 6 — to confirm that, please get me the updated manifest (with corrected SKU names), the public ARM template link, and the smoke test by Dec 30.

5) Co-sell: To enable co-sell benefits, Contoso will need to be registered as a customer on the marketplace entry and provide a contact for the Microsoft channel team.

I'll attach a small checklist and the publisher consent PDF in a follow-up. Happy to jump on a short sync next week to walk through specific manifest changes.

Best,
Alyssa

--
Alyssa Chen
Partner Engineering, Microsoft Marketplace
alyssa.chen@microsoft.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 08:09:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace publisher bootstrapping — internal checklist

Tessa / team — quick internal plan after Alyssa's notes: 

1) Markus: can you update the manifest SKU strings and push a new redwood-manifest-v2.zip by 12/29? Focus on matching these names: Standard_ND96asr_v4, Standard_ND40rs_v3 for our Dedicated SKUs.

2) Soojin: please make a public container with the ARM templates and smoke-test scripts, provide a transient SAS URL (expires 1/15/2027) and drop link in the HubSpot deal. We should also sanitize environment secrets.

3) Laura (me): I'll draft the publisher consent email and coordinate with Contoso procurement to determine whether they want their own publisher tenant. If Contoso wants separate tenancy, we need that decision by 12/27 to avoid blocking the Jan 6 validation slot.

4) Tessa: I'll run through the validation-test-plan.pdf and add expected artifact names for the validation engineer.

We'll hold a 20-min sync on Wed 12/22 at 10:30 PT to confirm owners.

- Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Growth Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attaching redwood-manifest-v2.zip (contains corrected SKU identifiers and updated offer SKU descriptions). Also included a short README that maps our internal SKU labels to Azure marketplace VM family names.

Notes:
- ARM templates are staged to a public container: https://storage.azure.com/redwood-marketplace-public/arm-templates?sv=... (SAS will be issued to Alyssa once we finalize).
- Smoke test script: ./scripts/smoke_test_gpu.sh — uses sample input in /samples; writes logs to azure-poc-logs-20261219.txt (attached).

I'll remove any hard-coded secrets and regenerate templates once Laura signs off.

-Markus

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@microsoft.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 14:31:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace publisher bootstrapping — next steps and DocuSign

Tessa / all — thanks, I reviewed the v2 manifest and the smoke test logs. Good progress. A couple final items to clear before we lock Jan 6: 

- I validated the GPU SKU mappings; those look correct now.
- Please confirm the public ARM template link with SAS and that the smoke test will run without interactive prompts.
- Contoso procurement: we need the signed publisher consent if they don't want to be under Redwood's tenant. I sent the consent PowerForm link to procurement@contoso.com — can you confirm receipt?

I opened an official validation slot for Jan 6 at 09:00 PT. If everything arrives by Dec 30 I'll confirm. Also sharing the DocuSign powerform for the publisher agreement: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234

If you want to add CloudBridge as an integration partner on the offer listing, please provide their integration summary and logo assets by Dec 28 so branding checks can be completed.

I'll be OOO Dec 24–27 but will have coverage; feel free to use the portal checklist link I sent earlier.

Thanks — Alyssa

--
Alyssa Chen
Partner Engineering, Microsoft Marketplace
